# Los Angeles Fire Department

> The Los Angeles Fire Department (LAFD) provides comprehensive fire safety, emergency preparedness, and community resources for Los Angeles residents and businesses.

LAFD serves as the primary source for fire prevention, emergency response coordination, and public safety education across Los Angeles. The department manages multiple bureaus and specialized units including Fire Development Services, the Film Unit, and hazmat compliance programs.

## Key Topics

- Fire Prevention
- Fire Safety
- Wildfire Preparedness
- Emergency Evacuation
- Red Flag No Parking
- Home Safety
- First Aid & CPR
- Fire Code Compliance
- Disaster Readiness
- Community Resources
- Brush Clearance
- Fire Stat LA
- CERT Program
- Cannabis Compliance
- Film Permits

## Emergency Response & Real-Time Information

- [Live](https://lafd.org/live): Live emergency alerts and Fire Stat LA real-time fire department data
- [Wildfire](https://lafd.org/wildfire): Wildfire preparedness, evacuation info, and home hardening resources
- [Red Flag](https://lafd.org/redflag): Red Flag Parking Restrictions Program for high fire hazard zones

## Community Safety & Preparedness

- [Los Angeles Fire Department](https://lafd.org): LAFD homepage with fire safety, preparedness, and community resources
- [Safety](https://lafd.org/safety): Emergency preparedness, fire prevention, and community safety hub
- [Disaster Preparedness](https://lafd.org/safety/disaster-preparedness): Disaster preparedness training and CERT program resources for LA
- [Home Safety](https://lafd.org/node/94956): Home safety guide covering smoke alarms, cooking, electrical hazards
- [First Aid](https://lafd.org/first-aid): First aid training including CPR, bleeding, and life-saving techniques
- [Adopt a Fire Station](https://lafd.org/fire-stations/adopt-fire-station): Adopt-a-Fire Station community support and fundraising program

## Fire Prevention & Code Compliance

- [Fire Code](https://lafd.org/fire-prevention/fire-code): 2023 LA Fire Code, California Fire Code, and municipal regulations
- [Fire Development Services](https://lafd.org/fire-prevention/fire-development-services): Fire permits, plan checks, and construction fire code compliance
- [BRUSH](https://lafd.org/fire-prevention/brush): Brush clearance program and vegetation management for fire prevention
- [Industrial and Commercial](https://lafd.org/fire-prevention/industrial-and-commercial): Industrial/commercial inspections and fire hazard compliance guidance
- [Chief's Regulation 4](https://lafd.org/fire-prevention/chiefs-regulation-4): Chief's Regulation 4 fire safety equipment certification standards

## Specialized Programs & Permits

- [Film Unit](https://lafd.org/film-unit): Film permits, pyrotechnics, and special effects fire safety oversight
- [Cannabis Unit](https://lafd.org/cannabis): Cannabis compliance, fire safety inspections, and permit requirements
- [CUPA](https://lafd.org/fire-prevention/cupa): CUPA hazmat program navigation and contact directory
